mapper.sql: cmd_id, message_id, cmd_text, target_host_ids, decision, decision_user, decision_time, cmd_fingerprint, is_high_risk, exec_status, exec_result, exec_ms, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_command(cmd_id, message_id, cmd_text, target_host_ids, decision, cmd_fingerprint, is_high_risk, exec_status, create_time) VALUES(#{cmdId}, #{messageId}, #{cmdText}, #{targetHostIds}, #{decision}, #{cmdFingerprint}, #{isHighRisk}, #{execStatus}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_command SET decision = #{decision}, decision_user = #{user}, decision_time = NOW() WHERE cmd_id = #{cmdId}
UPDATE ai_command SET exec_status = #{execStatus}, exec_result = #{execResult}, exec_ms = #{execMs} WHERE cmd_id = #{cmdId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_command WHERE message_id IN (SELECT message_id FROM ai_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId})
